svg.aria-label: Kimi-Linear-48B at TP4. Main pads every KDA state to the 512-token MLA page and runs four groups over seven shared per-layer tensors. With large pages, the pool is a list of 32.1 MiB pages; each page belongs to one of two groups, which fits 3 KDA blocks or 64 MLA blocks of 64 tokens.
svg.text: One group per spec instead of equal page sizes
Kimi-Linear-48B, TP4: 20 KDA layers, 7 MLA layers. Schematic, not to scale.
Every page is 589,824 B = 512 MLA tokens.
Each KDA state (561,152 B) is padded by 5.1%.
large pages: one owner per page
free: any group can take it
A KDA block holds the states of all 20 layers (10.7 MiB).
An MLA page leaves a 1.9% tail; the planner bounds waste at 2%.
